title: The slide into Edit mode draws every frame, like the slide back to View
goal: Going from View to Edit, the tool bar, tracks and panel slide in at a low frame rate: the window draws a new frame only every 10 to 60 ms while they move, even on a short recording, so the slide looks choppy. Going back to View is smooth. Make the slide into Edit as smooth as the slide out.
notes: Found 2026-09-29 by switching-a-long-recording-to-edit-mode-draws-it, after it split the Cmd-2 key pass up (EditModeArrival). Reproduce: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/segmented-thumb-film-walk.json, then read /tmp/photonz-playtest/segmented-thumb-film/1-view-to-edit.json frames. Output 2026-09-29: View to Edit thumb positions change at ms 289, 351, 360, 375, 411, 421, 429, 437, 491, 500 (steps of 10 to 62ms); Edit to View changes every ~9ms from 256 to 495. Long captioned sample (Scripts/playtest/view-to-edit-on-a-long-recording-walk.json): wait after Cmd-2 reads mainBusy 633 to 758ms over 0.8s, with passes of 30 to 50ms all through the 250ms slide; after Cmd-1 about 530ms. Suspects: the panel move transition narrows the canvas every frame (HStack), so the canvas, its viewport refit, the tool bar fit budget (reconcileToolbarCount) and the whole panel lay out per frame; the dock growing relays the grid every frame. Idea: slide the panel with an offset over a fixed canvas width and refit once at the end.
acceptance: Filming the View | Edit thumb on Cmd-2 (segmented-thumb-film-walk, 1-view-to-edit) shows a new position at least every 20ms once it starts moving, as Edit to View already does
On the long captioned sample, the main thread is busy for well under half of the 0.8s after Cmd-2 (it is about 650 to 750ms today)
View mode playback is no slower

log.note: Reproduced 2026-09-30. Thumb film no longer measures anything (the View | Edit control is the system's own; thumbPt stayed constant), so added a filmWindow walk step (films the window below the title bar, reports when it drew each new picture). Filmed on the 5 min captioned sample: staged arrivals during the slide gave 8-9 pictures in the first 330ms, 90-123ms apart; Edit to View ~8-20ms apart. xctrace profile: both directions ~480ms main busy per switch; into Edit the arrival passes (40-90ms each) land during the motion.

Fix: every stage after the key pass waits for the slide to land (EditModeArrival.nextWaitsForTheSlide, EditorState.advanceEditArrivalOnceTheSlideLands with a generation guard). Filmed after: 22-25 pictures in the slide, longest still 17-19ms. Also: Measure legend moved into its own view (its anchor read the viewport, so the editor's layout closure re-ran every frame, ~100 times per switch, now ~20); InspectorPanel is Equatable/.equatable() (no inputs); clipToTrim walks layers in place instead of copying allLayers. Variants measured: one pass after the slide (same smoothness, 110-150ms stall), all at the key (326ms before anything moves), tool bar with the key pass (+30-40ms latency). Chose staged-after.

Acceptance: (1) met, measured by filmWindow instead of the thumb (longest still 17-19ms in the slide; walk claims <30ms). (2) NOT met: mainBusy after Cmd-2 still 626-684ms; the time is the same, it just no longer lands in the slide. Filed edit-mode-s-contents-come-in-with-the-slide-not for it. (3) View playback untouched by the change (arrival timing only runs on a switch; legend/panel/clipToTrim changes only remove work); playing-a-recording-never-blinks, a-faded-title-shows-while-playing, an-editing-session walks green; not measured against a baseline build. Walks green: 16 edit-mode walks, legend/measure walks, segmented thumb walks. Full suite 10674 passed. Left rough (audit rough, not filed separately): film frames are half size below the title bar.

Stages after the key pass wait for the slide to land (EditModeArrival.nextWaitsForTheSlide); filmed slide now 22-25 pictures, longest still 17-19ms (was 90-123ms). Legend isolated, panel equatable, clipToTrim no-copy. New filmWindow walk step; view-to-edit-on-a-long-recording-walk claims <30ms. Main-thread busy unchanged (criterion 2 not met), follow-up edit-mode-s-contents-come-in-with-the-slide-not filed. Suite 10674 green, 28 related walks green.
